title: Row count bounded by the size scale
statement: Let $k,n,N,D$ be nonnegative integers satisfying $1\le k\le n$, $0<N$, and $2N\le D$. Define $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, the row count $r=(k-1)d+1$, and the size scale $s=k(d+1)$. Then $r\le s$.
